summary: Build, vet, and test all pass (exit 0). Blocking security finding in the new credential preflight: validateScanExclude accepts a symlink exclude and excludePathRule resolves it to the symlink target, so a candidate can hide a real credential file (or the entire scanned tree via a symlink to '.') without naming the actual path. Repro on this SHA: a worktree containing credentials.txt with a detector hit and forest.secrets.yaml 'exclude: - innocent_link' where innocent_link is a symlink to credentials.txt makes 'forest scan-secrets <dir>' exit 0; without the symlink exclude it fails on that file. Required fix: reject symlink excludes (or require the resolved target to stay inside the scanned tree and equal the configured path) and do not resolve symlinks when building the exclusion rule.
